steps: Check the MCA filing history for MGT-7/7A and AOC-4 of the previous year
Note filing dates against due dates
Record any default
items.text: Previous year's annual return (MGT-7/7A) and financial statements (AOC-4) filed on time.

steps: Count board meetings in the minutes book and check the gap between meetings
Check the AGM date against the due date
Record shortfalls
items.text: Minimum four board meetings with gap not exceeding 120 days; AGM held within the due date.

steps: Confirm where the books are kept
Obtain the server location and daily backup log
Confirm the backup server is in India
items.text: Books kept at the registered office; electronic books backed up daily on a server in India.

steps: Scan ledgers of directors and their related entities
Identify loans, guarantees or security given
Check each against s.185 exemptions
items.text: No prohibited loans, guarantees or security given to directors or interested persons.

steps: List loans, guarantees and investments made in the year
Compare with s.186 limits and check approvals
Verify the register MBP-2
items.text: Loans, guarantees and investments within limits and approved by board / special resolution where needed.

steps: List related-party contracts from the register
Check board / shareholder approvals where required
Agree with AOC-2 in the board report
items.text: Related-party contracts approved by board / shareholders where required; AOC-2 attached to board report.

steps: Obtain MBP-1 from every director for the year
Check register MBP-4 is updated
Note late or missing disclosures
items.text: Directors' disclosures (MBP-1) received; register of contracts (MBP-4) maintained.

steps: Obtain DIR-8 from each director
Check MCA director status
Record any disqualification
items.text: Written representations obtained that no director is disqualified.

steps: Check DIR-3 KYC status for each DIN on the MCA portal
Note any deactivated DIN
Record conclusion
items.text: DIR-3 KYC completed for all directors.

steps: Compute managerial remuneration against s.197 / Schedule V limits
Check the approvals
Record any excess
items.text: Managerial remuneration within limits for public companies; approvals in place.

steps: List all loans received and classify them under the Deposit Rules
Check DPT-3 filing
Record any deposit accepted in breach
items.text: No deposits accepted in breach; DPT-3 return of deposits / exempted loans filed.

steps: Obtain the allotment file for shares issued
Check approvals, PAS-3 filing and separate bank account
Record exceptions
items.text: Allotments made with valid approvals; PAS-3 filed; money received in separate bank account (private placement).

items.how: MCA charge index vs sanction letters.
steps: Compare the MCA charge index with sanction letters
Check charges created / satisfied in the year are filed
Record missing filings
items.text: Charges created and satisfied registered with ROC.

steps: Check dividend is paid out of profits
Check unpaid dividend transfer and IEPF transfers
Record delays
items.text: Dividend declared out of profits; unpaid dividend transferred within time; IEPF transfers done.

steps: Obtain BEN-1 declarations
Check BEN-2 filing
Record conclusion
items.text: Significant beneficial ownership declarations received and filed.

steps: Run the board report checklist under s.134
Check CSR, RPT, POSH and risk management statements
Record omissions
items.text: Board report contains all required items (including CSR, RPT, POSH statement, risk management).

steps: Check turnover against cost record / cost audit thresholds
Check the cost auditor appointment (CRA-2)
Record conclusion
items.text: Applicability of cost records and cost audit checked; cost auditor appointed where required.

steps: Check applicability of secretarial audit and whole-time KMP
Obtain MR-3 and KMP appointment records
Record conclusion
items.text: Secretarial audit and appointment of whole-time KMP checked where applicable.

steps: Run the s.143(3)(a)–(h) checklist
Confirm each reporting item with evidence
Draft the reporting paragraphs
items.text: Report items covered: information obtained, proper books, agreement with books, compliance with AS, disqualification of directors.

steps: Obtain the list of pending litigation and long-term contracts
Check IEPF transfers
Draft the Rule 11(a)–(d) paragraphs
items.text: Pending litigation, foreseeable losses on long-term contracts and IEPF transfers reported.

steps: Obtain management representations on funds through intermediaries
Perform procedures on large advances / receipts
Draft the Rule 11(e) paragraph
items.text: Management representations on funds advanced to or received from intermediaries obtained and tested.

steps: Check dividend declared or paid against s.123
Note any non-compliance
Draft the Rule 11(f) paragraph
items.text: Dividend declared or paid complies with s.123.

steps: Review the fraud log and whistle-blower complaints
Decide on reporting to the audit committee or Central Government (ADT-4)
Document the decision
items.text: Frauds by officers or employees above the threshold reported to the Central Government; smaller ones reported to the audit committee.
